title: Better Than Boats
description: A Minecraft mod that adds five new boats that change the way you can play the game
body:
# Better than Boats - Your Mobile Base on the Water

Tired of constantly returning to land during your ocean expeditions? **Better than Boats** transforms the open water into your permanent, mobile base.

Built for **NeoForge**, this mod introduces **5 new functional boat variants** that allow you to assemble a fully equipped water caravan. Seamlessly transport massive amounts of cargo, craft on the go, smelt ores, and sleep during long-distance journeys, completely eliminating the need to ever drop anchor or build on land.

---

## Features

This mod adds the following functional boat variants to the game:

1. **Boat with Crafting Table:** Craft items on the go without leaving your vessel.
2. **Boat with Furnace:** Smelt ores and cook food while sailing across oceans.
3. **Boat with Double Chest:** Offers massive inventory space for long-distance resource transport. *Note: This boat is not ridable, but you can link it to your other boats using a Lead.*
4. **Boat with Bed:** Sleep on the water and set a persistent, mobile spawn point during long voyages. *Note: This boat is not ridable during normal travel, but you can link it to other boats using a Lead.*
5. **Boat with Ender Chest:** Access your global Ender inventory securely from anywhere in the world.

---

## Boat with Bed - Spawn Point Mechanics

The Boat with Bed acts as a moving respawn point that follows your water caravan. 

* **Set Spawn Anytime:** Right-click the boat during the day to set your spawn point immediately, even if it is too early to sleep.
* **Interruption-Free Sleep:** Sleeping at night works as normal, but moving waves or towing the boat on a lead will not kick you out of bed.
* **Moving Spawn Point:** The boat constantly updates your spawn coordinates as it drifts or gets towed. You will always respawn right where the boat is.
* **Smart Respawn:** If you die, the mod searches for the boat even if it drifted or its chunk is unloaded. In the worst-case scenario, you respawn at the boat's last known position instead of the world spawn.
* **Unlinking:** Sleeping in a regular bed on land safely resets your spawn point back to normal.
* **Dimension Danger:** Traditional rules apply. Right-clicking the boat in the Nether or the End causes an explosion.
